Assuming that an "active" user is defined as any user with at least one session (count > 0), the function will simply count all elements in the list that are greater than zero.

Confidence level: 95%

```python
def count_active(sessions):
    """
    Returns the number of active users, defined as users having more than 0 sessions.
    """
    return sum(1 for count in sessions if count > 0)
```
